'''Duane Bruun''' was a PC staff writer for the [[Players Committee]].<ref name="yearend">[https://web.archive.org/web/20030613110815/http://swccgpc.com:80/News/duane2002yearend.htm The State Of SWCCG], Duane Bruun (PC Staff Writer), swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 13 June 2003.</ref> He wrote the 2002 year-end column "The State Of SWCCG".<ref name="yearend" /> He was Shadow 47, in Bloomington-Normal, Illinois, on the Shadow Squadron rosters of 23 April 2003 and 4 June 2004.<ref name="vol2003">[https://web.archive.org/web/20030423194826/http://www.swccgpc.com/volunteers.htm Shadow Squadron], swccgpc.com, Internet Archive capture 23 April 2003.</ref><ref name="vol2004">[https://web.archive.org/web/20040604020531/http://www.swccgpc.com/volunteers.htm Shadow Squadron], swccgpc.com, Internet Archive capture 4 June 2004.</ref>
